title: README.md states the wrong item limit
description: README.md line 7 reads "A store holds at most 100 items. Adding one more raises `ListFull`." The code disagrees: tinytodo/store.py line 3 declares `MAX_ITEMS = 200`, and tests/test_store.py pins that value with `assert MAX_ITEMS == 200`. The CODE is correct and the prose is stale — the limit was raised from 100 to 200 and the README was never updated. Change the number 100 to 200 on README.md line 7 and change nothing else. Do not touch tinytodo/store.py, do not touch tests/test_store.py, and do not reflow or reformat any other line of README.md.
acceptance_criteria: no other line of README.md changes
